prompt: Static camera. A huge reddish-brown monster is wedged tightly through the broken wall of a cozy room, speaking angrily and comedically at a wooden desk. An open laptop sits on the desk in front of the monster, with its screen facing the monster. Its index finger stays fully extended and aligned with the laptop screen, and the fingertip remains aimed at the screen at all times. The pointing hand never redirects, retracts, lowers, or points anywhere else. It may make only tiny, tense emphasis motions or briefly spread its fingers into a slightly open hand; even while the hand is open, the whole hand and extended index finger remain firmly aimed at the laptop screen, then settle into exactly the same pointing pose. The monster keeps its intense gaze on the laptop while speaking into the black studio microphone. Its mouth moves naturally in precise sync with the speech, with restrained angry facial expressions, subtle eye movement, and occasional blinking. The head, pointing arm, enormous body, laptop, microphone, desk, broken wall, wooden frame, debris, lamp, and background otherwise remain almost completely still. The firm pointing direction toward the laptop screen is continuously preserved until the final frame.
